amendment.added: A second, reproduced recorder phase convention, a recorded-versus-contract phase-convention offset finding, and a pinned recorder source hash.
amendment.no_audit_result_existed: No audit had been executed and no audit output existed when this amendment was made, so no threshold, envelope, gate or outcome was changed in response to seeing a result.
amendment.reason: The freeze commit mapped a recorded command_phase to the start-of-control-step contract phase. Direct inspection of the recorder showed that the environment advances task_elapsed_s after the substep loop and only then re-samples the phase, so recorded labels follow an end-of-step accumulated-time convention. Under the freeze-commit rule AX-04 would have failed closed on the retained bundle because of a recording-convention difference rather than a data defect, which would have misreported a valid bundle as structurally invalid.
amendment.unchanged: The exposure horizon, the frozen task contract, the primary outcome, the censoring doctrine, the identification bounds, the descriptive sensitivity and every numerical threshold are unchanged by this amendment.
verified_evidence: backend/rl/humanoid_env.py:296-297 resets task_elapsed_s to 0.0 and samples the phase at 0.0, but that reset label is not recorded as a control-step label.
backend/rl/humanoid_env.py:352-353 executes task_elapsed_s += CTRL_DT and then _command_at(task_elapsed_s) after the substep loop.
backend/rl/humanoid_env.py:404 records the already advanced command_phase into the per-control-step info payload.
CTRL_DT = PHYS_DT * SUBSTEPS = 0.002 * 10 is the same IEEE 754 double as the literal 0.02 and as 1.0 / 50.0, so the accumulation is exactly reproducible from control_period_s.

Accumulated addition reaches 1.0000000000000004 after 50 additions, 6.499999999999949 after 325 and 7.999999999999917 after 400, so the START boundary advances one step early while the STOP and FINAL_STAND boundaries do not shift; exact multiplication would give a third, different answer.

changes: Non-comparable verdicts and blocked-aggregate reasons now name the actual cause instead of always naming exposure censoring.
An arm counts as having no comparable episode based on its comparability states alone; exposure class no longer masks it.
The retained method-failure doctrine is enforced in the descriptive sensitivity, which no longer emits an observed matched duty for a method-failure pair.
An episode with no exposure may not retain an observed primary outcome.
The estimand-existence convention behind the identification bounds is stated explicitly instead of being implied by the phrase assumption-free.
The replay check inventory is frozen and required exactly, the replay binds its inputs to the audited receipt inventory, and replay-receipt booleans are compared type-strictly.
A DEVELOPMENT bundle must retain the pinned audited protocol hash.
Validation re-derives the blocker list from the summary's own retained states, so a consistently re-stamped receipt cannot certify a rewritten summary.
The audited bundle's file set is compared before and after the audit, directory scans fail closed on unreadable subtrees, and output writes refuse to follow links.
Missing selection keys are no longer accepted as a preserved null selection.
amendment_2.claim_effect: No previously stated numerical result changed. The receipt's allowed conclusion was narrowed to remove a statement about the frozen v7 pilot that this run never measured.
amendment_2.no_scientific_threshold_changed: The exposure horizon, phase conventions, primary outcome, gate thresholds, bound formulae and seed inventory are unchanged. Every change either names a cause more precisely, adds a check, or narrows a claim.
amendment_2.trigger: Adversarial multi-dimension review of the implementation plus a differential sweep between the contract and replay builders.

arms.forbidden_seed_policy: Observing a retired or sealed seed in any audited artifact is a structural failure.

audited_protocol.development_bundle_pin_rule: A bundle declaring V7_PILOT_DEVELOPMENT_BUNDLE must retain protocol_sha256 equal to audited_protocol.protocol_sha256, and the retained protocol artifact must hash to the same value.

claim_boundary: SIM_ONLY_MUJOCO / NOT_PHYSICALLY_VALIDATED / DEVELOPMENT_ONLY. This audit may support only a statement about the internal validity of the retained v7 pilot contrast under unequal realized exposure. It creates no new performance result, selects no candidate arm, and does not support controller superiority, method-population power, formal sample-size adequacy, paper readiness, physical torque or thermal margins, safety, or sim-to-real claims.

comparability_states.COMPARABLE: The primary outcome is OBSERVED and the episode reached FULL_EXPOSURE, so the recorded value is the full-horizon estimand itself.
comparability_states.EXPOSURE_CENSORED: The primary outcome is arithmetically OBSERVED but the episode is EARLY_TERMINATED, so only a truncated window of the intended measurement support was realized.
comparability_states.METHOD_FAILURE_NOT_CENSORING: The primary outcome is NULL or NONFINITE, or the terminal record state is not COMPLETED, or the episode has NO_EXPOSURE.
comparability_states.classification_order: METHOD_FAILURE_NOT_CENSORING is decided first, then EXPOSURE_CENSORED, then COMPARABLE.
comparability_states.method_failure_doctrine: Following the project position already recorded in the paired statistics contract, a non-finite value, a solver or process error, a terminal failure, and a cancellation are method failures, not censoring. They are retained with frequency and reason and are never imputed, deleted, or silently converted into an observed value.
comparability_states.no_exposure_rule: An episode with no exposure may not retain an observed primary outcome; there is no measurement support for one, so it is a structural failure.
comparability_states.retention_rule: No episode is deleted, imputed, or re-run. Every retained arithmetic value stays in the audit output beside its comparability state and reason.

exposure_classes.EARLY_TERMINATED: observed_control_steps is greater than zero and less than full_exposure_control_steps.
exposure_classes.NO_EXPOSURE: observed_control_steps equals zero, which is the retained terminal-failure case.
exposure_classes.OVER_EXPOSURE: observed_control_steps exceeds full_exposure_control_steps and is a structural failure.

exposure_matched_sensitivity.aggregate_rule: A descriptive mean and sample standard deviation over the 30 per-seed matched differences is reported only when every pair has a matched value; otherwise the aggregate is null with a cause-named reason. Each per-seed difference is computed on its own truncation window, so the aggregate averages heterogeneous windows and carries no confirmatory interpretation.
exposure_matched_sensitivity.interpretation_limit: Truncation matching equalizes the measurement denominator only. It does not remove informative censoring, because the truncation point is produced by the arm's own early termination, and it does not recover the full-horizon estimand.
exposure_matched_sensitivity.matched_exposure_rule: For each evaluation seed the matched exposure k is min(reference observed_control_steps, candidate observed_control_steps).
exposure_matched_sensitivity.method_failure_rule: A pair whose reference or candidate episode is a retained method failure yields a null matched value even when its trace still carries usable counts. A retained method failure is never re-materialized as an observed matched duty.
exposure_matched_sensitivity.purpose: Show whether a candidate zero or near-zero duty survives once the reference arm is truncated to the same realized exposure.
exposure_matched_sensitivity.recomputation_rule: matched_duty_pct = 100 * sum(saturation_substeps_over_threshold[0:k]) / sum(saturation_substeps_total[0:k]) using only the retained per-control-step counts; k equal to zero yields a null matched value.

failure_semantics.audit_finding_is_not_a_failure: Concluding that a contrast is exposure-censored or non-comparable is a valid audit result, not a software failure.
failure_semantics.non_finite_policy: NaN and Infinity are never written as JSON numbers; they are retained as a typed NONFINITE state with a reason.
failure_semantics.retained_censoring_blocker: At least one non-comparable pair or censored primary-outcome value is retained, so pilot_planning_ready stays false.
failure_semantics.structural_failure: Source bundle drift, an output root inside or equal to the source bundle root, missing or duplicate or unexpected arm or seed, forbidden seed access, invalid JSON, duplicate JSON key, non-finite JSON number, path escape, bytes or SHA-256 mismatch, phase-schedule drift, exposure or denominator inconsistency, over-exposure, a non-null pilot selection, a source bundle class binding mismatch, or a replay mismatch.

frozen_task_horizon.derivation_rule: control_period_s = 1 / control_rate_hz; physics_substeps_per_control_step = physics_rate_hz / control_rate_hz; full_exposure_control_steps = duration_s * control_rate_hz; full_exposure_physics_substeps = full_exposure_control_steps * physics_substeps_per_control_step. Every quotient and product must be an exact integer or the audit fails closed.
frozen_task_horizon.no_new_constant_rule: The horizon is derived from the already frozen task contract and the already frozen pilot protocol. The audit introduces no new numerical threshold and changes none.

identification_bounds.applies_to: EXPOSURE_CENSORED and COMPARABLE episodes only; a METHOD_FAILURE_NOT_CENSORING episode has no bound and is retained as null.
identification_bounds.assumption_scope: The bounds are assumption-free with respect to the censoring distribution ONLY once the estimand is taken as the full-horizon duty defined by the frozen task contract. The existence of that estimand for an early-terminated episode is itself a contract convention: the full-horizon duty is a frozen task target, not an observed counterfactual of an episode that could have continued.
identification_bounds.degenerate_case: A FULL_EXPOSURE episode has observed_substeps equal to full_exposure_physics_substeps, so the lower and upper bounds coincide with the recorded value.
identification_bounds.lower_bound_rule: full_horizon_duty_lower_pct = 100 * observed_over_threshold_substeps / full_exposure_physics_substeps, which assumes every unobserved substep is below the saturation threshold.
identification_bounds.paired_bound_rule: paired_difference_lower = candidate_lower - reference_upper and paired_difference_upper = candidate_upper - reference_lower.
identification_bounds.rationale: The project position already recorded in the paired statistics contract is that until a censored estimator is frozen, only bounds are retained and ordinary mean and bootstrap procedures are blocked. This audit follows that rule and therefore reports bounds instead of a censored point estimate.
identification_bounds.sign_identification_rule: The paired contrast sign is identified only when the paired difference bound excludes zero. A bound that contains zero leaves the direction of the effect unidentified without an additional, currently unfrozen, censoring assumption.
identification_bounds.upper_bound_rule: full_horizon_duty_upper_pct = 100 * (observed_over_threshold_substeps + full_exposure_physics_substeps - observed_substeps) / full_exposure_physics_substeps, which assumes every unobserved substep is above the saturation threshold.

objective: Reconstruct per-episode termination control step, termination sim time, and termination phase from the retained v7 action-interface pilot raw traces; derive realized exposure against the already frozen task horizon; and state explicitly which primary-outcome values and which paired contrasts are comparable, which are exposure-censored, and which are retained method failures.

paired_comparability.aggregate_rule: The audited paired mean and sample standard deviation are reported only when all 30 pairs are COMPARABLE. Otherwise the aggregate is null with reason BLOCKED_EXPOSURE_CENSORED_PAIRS_RETAINED_NO_COMPLETE_CASE_DELETION.
paired_comparability.cause_attribution_rule: Every non-comparable verdict and every blocked aggregate must name the cause that actually produced it. Attributing a method-failure block to exposure censoring, or the reverse, is a misreport.
paired_comparability.comparable_rule: A pair is COMPARABLE only if both sides are COMPARABLE.
paired_comparability.no_complete_case_deletion: Restricting the aggregate to the comparable subset is forbidden, because the censoring indicator is produced by the arm's own early-termination behaviour and is therefore not independent of the outcome.
paired_comparability.retained_arithmetic_difference: The raw candidate-minus-reference arithmetic difference is retained for every pair whose two primary-outcome values are OBSERVED, including non-comparable pairs, and is explicitly labelled as not a valid contrast.

phase_convention.contract_rule: phase_first_control_step = start_s * control_rate_hz and phase_end_control_step_exclusive = end_s * control_rate_hz; control step k carries the contract phase whose half-open control-step interval contains k. Every boundary must be an exact control-step index.
phase_convention.contract_use: Reporting the frozen-contract phase that contains a reconstructed termination control step.
phase_convention.drift_policy: Any recorded phase that disagrees with the reproduced recorder convention, any unknown phase identifier, and any contract phase boundary that is not an exact control-step index are structural failures.
phase_convention.offset_finding_rule: The audit reports, for every phase, the first and last control step under both conventions and whether they agree. A disagreement is retained as a phase-convention validity finding and is never corrected in the retained data.
phase_convention.recorded_phase_cross_check: Every retained control-step record's command_phase must equal the reproduced recorder phase for that control-step index, and per-phase recorded coverage must equal the reproduced recorder coverage.
phase_convention.recorder_lookup_rule: phase = the first frozen phase whose half-open window satisfies start_s <= accumulated_s < end_s, otherwise the last frozen phase.
phase_convention.recorder_rule: The training environment advances task_elapsed_s by control_period_s AFTER the substep loop and only then re-samples the command phase, so the label recorded for control step k is the phase at the simulation time reached after k+1 additions of control_period_s. The audit reproduces that repeated addition exactly and must not substitute an exact product, because accumulated addition and exact multiplication disagree at phase boundaries.

phase_schedule_contract.note: Retained so that the freeze-commit wording stays visible; the operative rule is phase_convention.
phase_schedule_contract.phase_of_control_step_rule: phase_first_control_step = start_s * control_rate_hz and phase_end_control_step_exclusive = end_s * control_rate_hz; control step k belongs to the phase whose half-open control-step interval contains k.

primary_outcome.audit_finding: The denominator is proportional to realized exposure. A duty value accumulated over a truncated episode is a functional of a shorter measurement window and is not on the same support as the full-horizon estimand.
primary_outcome.definition: 100 * saturation_substeps_over_threshold / saturation_substeps_total accumulated over the retained control steps of one episode.
primary_outcome.exposure_denominator: saturation_substeps_total summed over the retained control steps of the episode

read_only_contract.post_audit_file_set_rule: The audited bundle's regular-file set is enumerated before and after the audit and must be identical, so a file added to or removed from the audited bundle during the run is a structural failure rather than an undetected change.

replay_contract.check_inventory_rule: The audit requires the replay receipt to carry exactly this check inventory, all true. A shorter or renamed inventory is a structural failure, so a rubber-stamp replay cannot satisfy AX-11.
replay_contract.independent_reconstruction: The replay recomputes exposure, termination, censoring classification, identification bounds, paired comparability, and the descriptive exposure-matched sensitivity from raw episode rows, and requires exact identity with the audit summary.
replay_contract.input_binding_rule: The replay requires the raw-episode, pilot-summary and retained-protocol files it is handed to match the SHA-256 values indexed by the audited pilot receipt, so it cannot mint a passing receipt over files that receipt never indexed.
replay_contract.what_identity_establishes: Exact identity establishes that the written summary is a faithful function of the retained raw rows under a separate interpreter with no project imports and no site-packages. It does not establish that the shared derivation rules are scientifically correct, because both implementations deliberately encode the same frozen rules.

source_bundle_classes.SYNTHETIC_REGRESSION_BUNDLE: A schema-exact synthetic bundle used only to exercise the audit software. It never supports any statement about the frozen v7 pilot.
source_bundle_classes.V7_PILOT_DEVELOPMENT_BUNDLE: The retained 2026-09-06 three-arm DEVELOPMENT pilot bundle whose receipt SHA-256 equals audited_protocol.frozen_pilot_receipt_sha256.
source_bundle_classes.class_binding_rule: A bundle whose receipt SHA-256 equals the frozen pilot receipt SHA-256 must declare V7_PILOT_DEVELOPMENT_BUNDLE; any other bundle must declare SYNTHETIC_REGRESSION_BUNDLE. A mismatch in either direction is a structural failure.
source_bundle_classes.synthetic_claim_rule: audit_applies_to_frozen_v7_pilot is true only for V7_PILOT_DEVELOPMENT_BUNDLE.
